summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K closing notice for the public distribution of 1,000,000 simple, non-convertible, unsecured debentures in a single series, with a nominal unit value of R$1,000, totaling R$1 billion. The offering was conducted under Brazil's automatic registration procedure (CVM Resolution 160) with BTG Pactual and XP Investimentos as coordinators. The debentures were issued on June 15, 2026, and rated brAAA by S&P. This is a routine debt financing transaction with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring; it represents ordinary capital markets activity.
